intro: Garrick's Head is the severed head of Garrick Padfoot, a notorious cutthroat operating near the vineyards of Northshire Valley. It serves as gruesome proof of death to claim a bounty issued by the authorities at Northshire Abbey.

p: For weeks, Garrick Padfoot and his gang of thugs harassed local farmers and merchants across Northshire Valley. Taking advantage of the Kingdom of Stormwind's stretched defenses, Garrick holed up in a shack near the Northshire vineyards, raiding passing trade. With local guards pinned down by encroaching kobolds and Defias bandits, Deputy Willem placed a bounty on Padfoot's head, seeking an enterprising adventurer to eliminate the outlaw and present undeniable proof of his demise.
